sentences.zh: 我一听说

sentences.zh: 与朝鲜的关系处于什么状态？

sentences.en: You know, Michael, for a quarter century,
sentences.zh: 你知道，迈克尔，四分之一世纪以来，

sentences.en: American presidents have been trying to solve the intractable problem of the North Korean nuclear program.
sentences.zh: 历任美国总统一直试图解决朝鲜核计划这个棘手的问题。

sentences.en: This is a good deal for the United States.
sentences.zh: 这对美国来说是一笔好买卖。

sentences.en: North Korea will freeze and then dismantle its nuclear program.
sentences.zh: 朝鲜将冻结并随后拆除其核计划。

sentences.en: Bill Clinton negotiated a big deal in 1994 after the two countries came pretty close to war over the North's nuclear ambitions.
sentences.zh: 在两国因朝鲜的核雄心几乎濒临战争边缘之后，比尔·克林顿于1994年谈判达成了一项重大协议。

sentences.en: South Korea and our other allies will be better protected.
sentences.zh: 韩国和我们的其他盟友将得到更好的保护。

sentences.en: The entire world will be safer as we slow the spread of nuclear weapons.
sentences.zh: 随着我们减缓核武器的扩散，整个世界将变得更加安全。

sentences.en: And that deal held for a while until the North cheated on it in a few years and started buying a different way to make a bomb.
sentences.zh: 该协议维持了一段时间，直到几年后朝鲜违反协议，开始寻求另一种制造炸弹的方法。

sentences.en: Last night, the government of North Korea proclaimed to the world that it had conducted a nuclear teSt. We're working to confirm North Korea's claim.
sentences.zh: 昨晚，朝鲜政府向全世界宣布，它进行了一次核试验。我们正在努力证实朝鲜的说法。

sentences.en: George W.
sentences.zh: 乔治·W·

sentences.en: Bush threatened the North
sentences.zh: 布什曾在不同时期威胁过朝鲜

sentences.en: Koreans at various moments, but ended up signing a deal with them.
sentences.zh: 人，但最终还是与他们签署了一项协议。

sentences.zh: 朝鲜人实际上炸毁了宁边反应堆的一部分。

sentences.en: And to demonstrate its commitment, North Korea has said it will destroy the cooling tower of the Yongbyon reactor in front of international television cameras tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 为了表现其诚意，朝鲜表示将于明天在国际电视摄像机前摧毁宁边反应堆的冷却塔。

sentences.en: They rebuilt it later.
sentences.zh: 他们后来又重建了它。

sentences.en: Say a few words about North Korea's announcement that it has conducted a nuclear teSt. And President Obama, as well as its decision to attempt a short-range missile launch,
sentences.zh: 请简单谈谈朝鲜关于其已进行核试验的声明，以及奥巴马总统（以及它决定尝试发射短程导弹的决定），

sentences.en: who was pretty angered when the North Koreans greeted his first months in office with a nuclear test,
sentences.zh: 他在朝鲜人以核试验迎接他上任头几个月时感到相当愤怒，

sentences.en: ultimately ended up trying a small offer with the North Koreans and it fell apart too.
sentences.zh: 最终还是试图向朝鲜人提出一份小妥协，结果也破裂了。

sentences.en: We do believe that if there are any signs at any point that North Korea is serious about dialogue around denuclearization
sentences.zh: 我们确实相信，如果在任何时候有任何迹象表明朝鲜认真对待关于朝鲜半岛无核化的对话，

sentences.en: in the Korean Peninsula, that we'll be ready to have those conversations.
sentences.zh: 我们将随时准备进行这些对话。

sentences.en: And then came President Trump.
sentences.zh: 然后特朗普总统登场了。

sentences.en: The United States has great strength and patience, but if it is forced to defend itself for its allies, we will have no choice but to totally destroy North Korea.
sentences.zh: 美国拥有巨大的实力和耐心，但如果被迫保卫自己或盟友，我们将别无选择，只能彻底摧毁朝鲜。

sentences.en: Who at first threatened fire and fury and suggested he might go to war with North Korea before he became the first president to actually meet with one of its leaders.
sentences.zh: 他起初威胁要使用烈怒与战火，并暗示可能会对朝鲜动武，随后他成为了第一位真正与朝鲜最高领导人会面的美国总统。

sentences.en: And how did that meeting play out?
sentences.zh: 那次会晤进展如何？

sentences.en: Well, that meeting was last June in Singapore.
sentences.zh: 嗯，那次会晤是去年六月在新加坡举行的。

sentences.en: It was really great.
sentences.zh: 真的很棒。

sentences.en: I had a great discussion and I think tremendous success.
sentences.zh: 我进行了一次非常愉快的讨论，我认为取得了巨大的成功。

sentences.en: Tremendously successful.
sentences.zh: 取得巨大成功。

sentences.en: And you'll remember that it was just a day.
sentences.zh: 你会记得那只有一天。

sentences.en: And we'll go back and forth.
sentences.zh: 我们会进行来回讨论。

sentences.en: And then we fell in love.
sentences.zh: 然后我们坠入爱河了。

sentences.en: Okay?
sentences.zh: 好吗？

sentences.en: No, really.
sentences.zh: 不，真的。

sentences.en: He wrote me beautiful letters.
sentences.zh: 他写给我非常漂亮的信。

sentences.en: And they're great letters.
sentences.zh: 而且都是极好的信。

sentences.en: But President Trump, who has always had an affection for authoritarian leaders and dictators,
sentences.zh: 但一直对独裁者和威权领导人抱有好感的特朗普总统，

sentences.en: suddenly declared that Kim Jong-un, a man who has sent thousands of people to the gulags,
sentences.zh: 突然宣布金正恩——一个将数千人送进古拉格、

sentences.en: murdered family members who challenged him, was actually a really progressive and interesting leader.
sentences.zh: 谋杀过挑战他的家庭成员的人——实际上是一个非常开明且有趣的领袖。

sentences.en: I think that he really wants to do a great job for North Korea.
sentences.zh: 我认为他是真的很想为朝鲜做出一番伟大的成就。

sentences.en: I think he wants to denuke.
sentences.zh: 我认为他想要去核。

sentences.en: It's very important.
sentences.zh: 这非常重要。

sentences.en: Without that, there's nothing to discuss.
sentences.zh: 如果没有这个，就没什么好谈的。

sentences.en: That was on the table at the beginning and you see a total denuclearization of North Korea.
sentences.zh: 这从一开始就摆在桌面上，你看，朝鲜实现了完全无核化。

sentences.en: So important.
sentences.zh: 太重要了。

sentences.en: And they put together a communique back in June that had a lot of vague promises about denuclearization,
sentences.zh: 他们在六月份发表了一份公报，其中包含许多关于无核化的模糊承诺，

sentences.en: about steps the United States would take to normalize its relationship with the North.
sentences.zh: 以及美国为实现与朝鲜关系正常化将采取的步骤。

sentences.en: But almost as soon as they left Singapore...
sentences.zh: 但几乎就在他们离开新加坡之后……

sentences.en: Well, I think the most reasonable assessment you can make of it is that we don't know if it's going to work out or not.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我认为你可以对它做出的最合理的评估是，我们不知道它是否会成功。

sentences.en: I'm deeply skeptical of the summit because nothing was actually achieved.
sentences.zh: 我对这次峰会深表怀疑，因为实际上什么也没有达成。

sentences.en: Will he accept inspectors inside his country to verify the destruction of nuclear weapons?
sentences.zh: 他会接受国际视察员进入其国内以核实核武器的销毁吗？

sentences.en: People were wondering, what does this add up to?
sentences.zh: 人们在想，这到底意味着什么？

sentences.en: Is this going to turn into real action?
sentences.zh: 这会变成真正的行动吗？

sentences.en: And what was the answer?
sentences.zh: 答案是什么？

sentences.en: Well, the answer was there wasn't much action.
sentences.zh: 嗯，答案是并没有什么实质行动。

sentences.en: The North Koreans kept saying, no, you have to relieve sanctions on us and improve the atmosphere of our relationship
sentences.zh: 朝鲜人一直说，不，你们必须解除对我们的制裁并改善我们关系的氛围，

sentences.en: before we'll feel secure enough to even begin to dismantle any part of our nuclear program.
sentences.zh: 然后我们才会感到足够安全，从而开始拆除我们的核计划的任何部分。

sentences.en: And the administration's position for a number of months was, no, you don't understand.
sentences.zh: 而政府几个月来的立场是，不，你们不明白。

sentences.en: You have to give up all of your weapons.
sentences.zh: 你们必须放弃你们所有的武器。

sentences.en: And as you're getting close to the end of that process, then we'll start lifting sanctions.
sentences.zh: 当你们接近这一进程的尾声时，我们才会开始解除制裁。

sentences.en: But you have to trust us that we'll do that.
sentences.zh: 但你们必须信任我们会这样做。

sentences.en: And they got stuck in that for a while.
sentences.zh: 他们在这个问题上僵持了一段时间。

sentences.en: Mike Pompeo, the Secretary of State, went over to North Korea to try to turn that communique that had been signed in Singapore into something real.
sentences.zh: 国务卿迈克·蓬佩奥前往朝鲜，试图将新加坡签署的那份公报变成真正的东西。

sentences.en: And Kim Jong-un wouldn't even really see him.
sentences.zh: 而金正恩甚至都不愿真正见他。

sentences.en: So it's been very slow.
sentences.zh: 所以进展非常缓慢。

sentences.en: And in part, it's been slow because the North Koreans have said, this is an issue so big that it can only be settled by the two top leaders, only by President Trump and Kim.
sentences.zh: 部分原因在于朝鲜人说过，这是一个如此重大的问题，只能由两位最高领导人来解决，只能由特朗普总统和金正恩来解决。

sentences.en: So, David, just to be clear, after round one of these negotiations last June between Trump and Kim, the issue is around basically who acts first, the U.S.
sentences.zh: 所以，大卫，为了明确起见，在去年六月特朗普和金正恩的第一轮谈判之后，问题基本上围绕着谁先采取行动：是美国

sentences.en: lifting these economic sanctions designed to discourage North Korea from developing
sentences.zh: 解除旨在阻止朝鲜发展或保留核武器的经济制裁，

sentences.en: or keeping nuclear weapons, or North Korea giving up those nuclear weapons or stopping its nuclear development.
sentences.zh: 还是朝鲜放弃核武器或停止其核开发。

sentences.en: That's absolutely right.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Because as in any such negotiation, Michael, no one wants to lose their leverage.
sentences.zh: 因为正如在任何此类谈判中一样，迈克尔，没有人愿意失去自己的筹码。

sentences.en: The only leverage the North Koreans have is that they've got the nuclear weapons.
sentences.zh: 朝鲜人唯一的筹码就是他们拥有核武器。

sentences.en: If North Korea didn't have nuclear weapons, we'd probably only think about them on World Food Day.
sentences.zh: 如果朝鲜没有核武器，我们大概只有在世界粮食日才会想起他们。

sentences.en: And they know it.
sentences.zh: 他们心知肚明。

sentences.en: And for the United States, the only real leverage we have are these international sanctions approved by the United Nations.
sentences.zh: 对于美国来说，我们拥有的唯一真正筹码就是联合国批准的这些国际制裁。

sentences.en: And as soon as they're lifted, the incentive for North Korea to do anything, especially destroy the weapons that it has invested in for 40 years, would disappear.
sentences.zh: 一旦这些制裁被解除，朝鲜采取任何行动的动力，尤其是摧毁其投资了40年的武器的动力，就会消失。

sentences.en: David, given how the first meeting went, which is that an agreement was reached that was vague
sentences.zh: 大卫，鉴于第一次会晤的情况——即达成了一项模糊不清、

sentences.en: and not all that meaningful and not all that meaningful, and it quickly began to unravel right afterwards,
sentences.zh: 并没有多大意义的协议，并且在事后不久就迅速破裂——

sentences.en: was there an indication that the negotiations would be approached differently this time with the idea of greater success?
sentences.zh: 是否有迹象表明这次谈判将采取不同的方法以期取得更大的成功？

sentences.en: Absolutely, Michael.
sentences.zh: 完全是这样，迈克尔。

sentences.en: This time they wanted to go into it better prepared.
sentences.zh: 这一次他们希望做更充分的准备再进入谈判。

sentences.en: There was a sense that you would have the agreement pretty well wrapped up and put on paper before the two leaders met.
sentences.zh: 有一种共识是，在两位领导人会晤之前，应该把协议基本敲定并落实在纸面上。

sentences.en: And that's pretty traditional in diplomatic meetings.
sentences.zh: 这在外交会晤中是相当传统的做法。

sentences.en: But on that very sensitive issue of who moves first, the answer was a sort of highly choreographed set of steps
sentences.zh: 但关于谁先迈出第一步这个非常敏感的问题，答案是一套高度编排的步骤，

sentences.en: in which the North Koreans would take certain steps toward denuclearization
sentences.zh: 其中朝鲜将采取某些迈向无核化的步骤，

sentences.en: and the Americans would slowly lift some peripheral sanctions and allow South Korea and North Korea to resume trade.
sentences.zh: 而美国将逐步解除一些外围制裁，并允许韩国和朝鲜恢复贸易。

sentences.en: So both sides were sort of moving in baby steps.
sentences.zh: 所以双方都在采取小步慢跑的方式。

sentences.en: So what would be different this time, according to these preparations, is that instead of there being confusion or a deadlock over who would act first, the U.S.
sentences.zh: 因此，根据这些准备工作，这次的不同之处在于，不会再对谁先采取行动（美国还是朝鲜）

sentences.en: or North Korea,
sentences.zh: 感到困惑或陷入僵局，

sentences.en: both countries would agree to take small simultaneous steps to create progress on denuclearization and sanction lifting and that that would create a better outcome.
sentences.zh: 而是两国将同意采取小的同步步骤，在无核化和解除制裁方面取得进展，从而带来更好的结果。

sentences.en: That's absolutely right.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: And in fact, President Trump seemed so eager to make that deal and so confident that it would come together that there was some suggestion that maybe he was too eager,
sentences.zh: 事实上，特朗普总统似乎非常渴望达成这项协议，并且对它能够达成充满信心，以至于有人暗示他可能表现得太急切了，

sentences.en: that the signaling to the North Koreans would be that he wanted a deal at any coSt.
sentences.zh: 向朝鲜释放的信号将是他不惜任何代价想要达成一笔交易。

sentences.en: In fact, they were so eager, Michael, that they set up a signing ceremony for a communique that the two leaders hadn't really approved yet
sentences.zh: 事实上，他们太急切了，迈克尔，以至于他们为一份两位领导人尚未真正批准的公报安排了一场签字仪式，

sentences.en: and then a big elaborate lunch to celebrate it all that they were planning to hold inside the hotel.
sentences.zh: 随后还计划在酒店内部举行一场精心筹备的大型午宴来庆祝这一切。

sentences.en: On Thursday afternoon, the table had already been set with fine china and the water already poured into the glasses.
sentences.zh: 周四下午，桌子已经摆好了精美的瓷器，杯子里也倒好了水。

sentences.en: Okay, so what actually happens?
sentences.zh: 好了，那实际上发生了什么？

sentences.en: Well, the first thing that happened was that Kim Jong-un arrived in his armored train.
sentences.zh: 嗯，发生的第一件事是金正恩乘他的装甲列车抵达了。

sentences.en: He doesn't like to fly, so he took it from North Korea up through China and then to the Vietnam border and then switched to a car and drove down to Hanoi.
sentences.zh: 他不喜欢坐飞机，所以他坐火车从朝鲜经中国北上，然后到达越南边境，接着换乘汽车开往河内。

sentences.en: President Trump was more traditional.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统则更为传统。

sentences.en: He came in Air Force One and they met on Wednesday night at the Metropole.
sentences.zh: 他乘坐空军一号抵达，两人于周三晚上在大都市酒店会面。

sentences.en: So we're going to have a very busy day tomorrow and we'll probably have a pretty quick dinner
sentences.zh: 所以我们明天将会有非常忙碌的一天，我们可能会吃一顿相当快捷的晚餐，

sentences.en: and a lot of things are going to be resolved, I hope, and I think it'll lead to wonderful, it'll lead to really a wonderful situation along the way.
sentences.zh: 很多事情将会得到解决，我希望如此，并且我认为这将带来美好的、沿途真正美好的局面。

sentences.en: They've had dinner at the Metropole, everything seemed warm, and it seemed like everything went exactly as planned.
sentences.zh: 他们在大都市酒店共进晚餐，一切看起来都很热烈，而且似乎一切都完全按计划进行。

sentences.en: And what happens next?
sentences.zh: 接下来发生了什么？

sentences.en: Well, on Thursday morning, I was sitting in the breakfast room at the Metropole, enjoying a good bowl of pho, when all of a sudden I looked up in the window and
sentences.zh: 嗯，周四早上，我正坐在大都市酒店的早餐厅里，享用着一碗美味的河粉，突然我抬头看向窗户，

sentences.en: the president's motorcade shows up.
sentences.zh: 总统的车队出现了。

sentences.en: I see him walk into the building and he begins to meet with Kim.
sentences.zh: 我看到他走进大楼，并开始与金会面。

sentences.en: And then we started getting these funny little indications from the reporters who were in the pool, the small group that follows the president around.
sentences.zh: 然后我们开始从随团记者——也就是跟随总统左右的小型记者团——那里听到一些奇怪的小迹象。

sentences.en: They reported that the lunch had been canceled.
sentences.zh: 他们报告说午餐已经被取消了。

sentences.en: Well, that seemed strange since they'd already set the table.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这似乎很奇怪，因为他们已经摆好了桌子。

sentences.en: Then they reported there would be no signing of the communique.
sentences.zh: 接着他们报告说不会签署联合公报。

sentences.en: So we began to wonder, has something here gone truly wrong?
sentences.zh: 于是我们开始纳闷，这里出了什么大问题吗？

sentences.en: And then a statement arrived from Sarah Sanders, the press secretary, who said there would be no communique, that the talks had ended early,
sentences.zh: 随后，白宫新闻秘书萨拉·桑德斯发表了一份声明，称不会发表联合公报，会谈提前结束了，

sentences.en: that President Trump wanted to leave earlier, so he was going to hold the press conference a bit earlier.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统想要早点离开，所以他打算把记者会稍微提前举行。

sentences.en: And it became pretty clear pretty fast that whatever they were trying to accomplish had really fallen apart.
sentences.zh: 而且很快就变得非常清楚，无论他们试图达成什么目标，都已经彻底破裂了。

sentences.en: Ladies and gentlemen, the president of the United States and the secretary of state of the United States.
sentences.zh: 女士们先生们，美国总统和美国国务卿。

sentences.en: And then we all show up at this news conference in a big ballroom at the JW Marriott Hanoi and hope that President Trump will explain to us what happened.
sentences.zh: 然后我们所有人都出现在河内万豪酒店大宴会厅的这场新闻发布会上，希望特朗普总统能向我们解释发生了什么。

sentences.en: Well, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。

sentences.en: I want to begin by thanking the prime minister and president of Vietnam.
sentences.zh: 首先我要感谢越南的总理和主席。

sentences.en: And at this news conference, what do you learn has actually happened?
sentences.zh: 在这场新闻发布会上，你们了解到实际上发生了什么？

sentences.en: Why these negotiations seem to have fallen apart?
sentences.zh: 为什么这些谈判似乎破裂了？

sentences.en: So what was interesting, Michael, was what didn't happen.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔，有趣的是，什么都没有发生。

sentences.en: On North Korea, we just left Chairman Kim.
sentences.zh: 关于朝鲜，我们刚刚离开金委员长。

sentences.en: We had a really, I think, a very productive time.
sentences.zh: 我认为，我们度过了一段非常富有成效的时光。

sentences.en: We thought, and I thought, and Secretary Pompeo felt that it wasn't a good thing to be signing anything.
sentences.zh: 我们认为，我也认为，蓬佩奥国务卿觉得签署任何协议都不是一件好事。

sentences.en: It became clear from listening to President Trump that the United States was not comfortable with the small number of concessions that the North Koreans wanted to give

sentences.en: in return for a big lifting of sanctions.
sentences.zh: 作为交换条件，他们希望大幅解除制裁。

sentences.en: Basically, they wanted the sanctions lifted in their entirety, and we couldn't do that.
sentences.zh: 基本上，他们希望彻底解除制裁，而我们做不到这一点。

sentences.en: And President Trump said outright that he was afraid we would all criticize him for giving away too much and not getting enough.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统直言不讳地说，他担心我们所有人都会批评他给予太多而得到的太少。

sentences.en: So he didn't sign.
sentences.zh: 所以他没有签字。

sentences.en: I could have signed an agreement today, and then you people would have said, oh, what a terrible deal, what a terrible thing he did.
sentences.zh: 我今天本可以签署一项协议，然后你们这些人就会说，哦，多么糟糕的交易，他做了一件多么糟糕的事。

sentences.en: No, you'll have to be prepared to walk.
sentences.zh: 不，你必须做好走人的准备。

sentences.en: And then, true dealmaker that he likes to say he is, he declared to all of us, you know, sometimes you have to walk away.
sentences.zh: 然后，正如他喜欢标榜自己是个真正的交易撮合者一样，他向我们所有人宣布，你知道，有时你必须一走了之。

sentences.en: So we continue to work and we'll see, but we had to walk away from that particular suggestion.
sentences.zh: 所以我们继续努力，我们会拭目以待，但我们不得不对那个特定的提议说不。

sentences.en: We had to walk away from that.
sentences.zh: 我们不得不放弃那个。

sentences.en: It became pretty clear as the negotiations went on that all that preparation work was really
sentences.zh: 随着谈判的进行，变得相当清楚的是，所有的前期筹备工作真的都

sentences.en: even though he wasn't prepared to give up, at least at that time, all of his nuclear facilities.

sentences.en: So just as last time, the problem is timing.

sentences.zh: 朝鲜人希望美国

sentences.en: wants.

sentences.zh: 他和金正恩坠入爱河，并且他们对彼此怀有最深的敬意，但他们在这一点上显然无法让步。

sentences.zh: 大卫，在这场新闻发布会期间甚至之后，你是否感觉到为什么金会提前同意在这次谈判中两国同时放弃某些东西，

sentences.en: the same time in this negotiation, and then would backtrack during the actual summit?
sentences.zh: 而在实际峰会期间又反悔了？

sentences.en: I think the interesting question is, in the end, did Kim ever really intend to agree to give
sentences.zh: 我认为有趣的问题是，到头来，金是否真的打算同意放弃——哪怕是随着时间的推移——他父亲和祖父在过去40年里投入了巨资的所有核基础设施？

sentences.en: away, even over time, all of the nuclear infrastructure that his father and his grandfather had invested in so heavily for the past 40 years?

sentences.en: Or did he think that he could get all the economic benefits and still hold on to at least enough

sentences.en: of his nuclear arsenal that he had the ultimate protection if things went bad with the United States?
sentences.zh: 他可能从来没有打算像美国所希望的那样真诚地进行谈判。

sentences.en: Hmm.

sentences.en: they could build beautiful hotels along their beaches and that they would make that trade for their nuclear weapons.
sentences.zh: 但我很好奇，美国总统和朝鲜领导人甚至还在对话，如此频繁地对话，共进晚餐，交换这些客套话，

sentences.en: And I think anybody who's watched the North Koreans over the years have realized they might give up

sentences.en: some of their nuclear weapons, but it's almost unimaginable they would give up all of them.
sentences.zh: 由于这些讨论，其发生的可能性似乎本质上降低了，并且这是一种进展，即使没有达成协议。

sentences.en: So it seems pretty clear that no progress was made at this summit.
sentences.zh: 是的，我认为是这样的，迈克尔，因为如果你认为威胁是由两国之间的气氛以及朝鲜的能力共同决定的，

sentences.en: But I wonder if the fact that the U.S.
sentences.zh: 那么气氛无疑已经改善了。

sentences.en: president and the North Korean leader are even talking, talking this frequently, dining together, exchanging these pleasantries,

sentences.en: that that means that the thing that we most feared from the beginning, which is a nuclear conflict with North Korea, that that seems inherently lower as a possibility

sentences.en: But I think the relationship was very warm.
